page.layout: Top: two engraved medallion portraits side by side, each with a legend around the rim. Below them: one column of running text in two paragraphs, full width. No notes in the margins.

main_text.l: [SALMA] NASAR [?] [illegible, ~4 letters] [?] [medallion legends, left and right]
SALMANASAR Assyriorum Rex, magno comparato
exercitu pugnauit contra Samariam quam cepit, Hoseámque
regem Samariæ tributarium fecit.post aliquot annos cum nol-
let Hoseas amplius tributum persoluere,iterum venit in Sama-
riam Salmanasar, quam post tertium obsidionis annum cepit,
ac decem tribus in Assyriam abduxit, anno nono rebellionis
Hoseæ.qui erat annus mundi 3213. ante Christum natum 749.
hunc finem habuit regnum Israël, quod 242. annos steterat,
sub 17.Regibus: si sumas initium à morte Salomonis, & regno
Ieroboam filij Nabat,ad quem defecerat decem tribus, desci-
scentes à Roboam, filio Salomonis. Vide lib. 4. Reg. 17. & 18.
cap.Iosephi.lib.9.cap.15. De hoc Salmanasare dictum à me su-
pra est in Hosea.
SENNACHERIB Assyriorum Rex, blasphemus in
Deum, per nuntios minatus est Ezechiæ Regi Iudæ, & populo,
sic exclamantibus nuntiis: Audite verba Regis magni, Regis Assy-

l.i: riorum: hæc dicit Rex, Non vos seducat Ezechias, non enim poterit erue-
re vos de manu mea: neque fiduciam vobis tribuat super Dominum, di-
cens, eruens liberabit nos Dominus, & non tradetur civitas hæc in manu

main_text.l: Regis Assyriorum. Postea Sennacherib, Iudæam vastavit, Ieroso-
lyma obsedit. At vero tandem ad preces Esaiæ & Ezechiæ, An-
gelus Domini occidit una nocte 180000. militum Sennacherib,
anno mundi 3221. ante Christum natum 741. reuersus itaque
cum adoraret in templo Nefroch deum suum, Adramalech
& Sarafar, filij eius occiderunt eum. Vide lib. 4.Reg.18. & 19.cap.
& lib..2.Paral.cap.32.& Iosep.lib.Antiq.10.cap.1.& 2. De Senna-
cherib etiam mentionem feci in Ezechia.

page.notes: Medallion legends are partly worn: the left one reads SALMA and NASAR; the right one reads SENACHER and R AS, with the middle missing. Engraved portraits, no text notes in the margins. Printed "3213" and "3221" are spaced in the original as "3 2 1 3" and "3 2 2 1"; the "180000" figure is set as "180ooo" in the print and is copied here as read. The word "Nefroch" is printed as such (cf. Nisroch in the Vulgate), kept as printed.
